correctness.rationale: On the collinear ray, the Bregman optimality condition gives the exact dual recurrence \(h(t_{k+1})=h(t_k)+\gamma_{k+1}(c-t_k)\), with \(h(t)=t/\sqrt{1-t^2}\). Positive generated steps make \(t_k\) strictly increase. The source's objective-infimum result then forces the only possible limit to be the boundary minimizer \(t=1\). Since \(h(t_k)\to\infty\) while every increment is at most \((c+1)\gamma_k\), bounded cumulative step mass is impossible. Weighted Cesaro convergence gives \(h(t_k)/S_k\to c-1\), and inversion of \(h\) yields both stated \(S_k^{-2}\) asymptotics. An independent scalar replay on a divergent positive step schedule matched the leading constants; it was used only as a transcription check.
